description: This file is a shell script designed to test the git-http-backend functionality. It defines functions to perform HTTP GET and POST requests, verifies server responses, and includes test cases to validate various access scenarios for a Git repository served over HTTP. The script sets environment variables, sources external testing libraries, and performs output comparisons to ensure server behavior aligns with expectations.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified repository path and verifies the response status code matches the expected value.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with specified data and headers to the repository URL and verifies the response status code.

search-terms: shell script testing git over HTTP
